queries_run: Sterling Infrastructure STRL customer concentration data center customers risk 2026
Sterling Infrastructure STRL customer credit downgrade OR bankruptcy OR guidance cut 2026

findings.claim: FY2025 10-K：無單一客戶占合併營收逾10%；E-Infrastructure 前四大客戶占該部門營收27%（2024:31%、2023:40%），Building Solutions 前四大45%（36%、42%），Transportation 前四大州DOT 58%。
findings.excerpt: The top four customers in each year, accounted for 27% of the segment’s revenue in 2025, 31% in 2024 and 40% in 2023.

findings.claim: 10-K Note 18：2023-2025 無客戶占合併營收逾10%，2024與2025年底也無客戶占應收帳款逾10%。
findings.excerpt: No customers accounted for more than 10% of the Company’s consolidated revenues from continuing operations in 2025, 2024 or 2023. At December 31, 2025 and 2024, there were no customers that accounted for over 10% of the Company’s outstanding contract receivables.

customer_concentration_credit.note: 搜尋未見客戶破產、信用降評或客戶層級財務惡化的來源（聚合站稿件，未核一手）；未找到 Moody's/S&P 行動。
